presenters.name: Tim Ahemt
presenters.bio: ONE FM 98.5 breakfast host Monday and Tuesday.

presenters.bio: Wednesday breakfast host (The Big G) — from the fm985.com.au program guide.

presenters.name: Di Hunter
presenters.bio: Monday Afternoon — from the fm985.com.au program guide. Named archive portrait only.

presenters.name: Josh Revens
presenters.bio: Friday breakfast host and Monday Nights. Also conducts community interviews.

presenters.name: Johnny P (John Painter)
presenters.bio: Been on air for 4 years. Married to Eryl, lives in Mooroopna. Has 6 kids between them. Enjoys playing music from across the decades. Also interviews RoadSafe Goulburn Valley's Bill Winters.

presenters.name: Carlos Rock
presenters.bio: Has been on air for 19-20 years. Hosts the Planet of Sound program featuring rock music from across the decades.

presenters.name: Ralph Whitehead
presenters.bio: Married in 1966. Moved to Shepparton during the 1976 Christmas break. Long-time audio enthusiast and community radio presenter.

presenters.name: Timmy Ahmet
presenters.bio: Hosts the Good Evening Country program featuring country music.

presenters.name: Les 'Harro' Harrison
presenters.bio: Spent working life in education, in charge of schools for over 35 years. Interests include cricket, cycling, fishing, golf and being an active member of his local Lions Club.

presenters.name: Michael Costello
presenters.bio: Lived in Melbourne most of his life, had a 30 year involvement in Community Television.

presenters.name: Craig Stott
presenters.bio: Co-hosts the Saturday sports show with John Painter.

presenters.name: Rowan Farren-Parnell
presenters.bio: Member of the Mooroopna Community Planning Group. Interviews community figures and discusses local advocacy issues.

presenters.name: Fikiri
presenters.bio: Hosts the Africonnect program in Swahili, connecting the African community in the Goulburn Valley.

presenters.name: Jimmy
presenters.bio: Hosts the Mandarin language program and 'Her Quiet Strength' segment. Interviews guests in Mandarin with co-host Ivy.
